name: Pepper Cloud
description: Work with your Pepper Cloud CRM data directly in chat. Query and update records across modules like contacts and opportunities, log notes and tasks against them, check ticket status and details, and review quotations. Pull conversation summaries and sentiment insights, all grounded in your actual Pepper Cloud data. Learn more: https://blog.peppercloud.com/pepper-cloud-assistai-now-inside-claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pepper Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pepper Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://assistai.peppercloud.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pepper Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pepper Cloud lists 30 MCP tools, including change_quotation_status, check_xero_contact_link_tool, create_quotation, get_accessible_modules, get_activities, get_associated_records, get_conversation_users, get_conversations_aggregate, get_conversations_aggregate_paginated, get_crm_users, get_current_date, and get_exchange_rate.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pepper Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pepper Cloud in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Pepper Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pepper Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pepper Cloud is developed by Pepper Cloud. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
